description: Liquidations of perpetual positions on Hyperliquid and Helix (Injective) for one coin over the last 24 hours and 7 days: long and short USD totals, event counts and the largest liquidation. Each venue shows up to which time its feed has been read. Coins are those of the open liquidation summary: ETH, SOL, BNB, AVAX, ATOM, INJ, TIA, DYDX, ASTER. BTC is not part of this open summary.
